name: @hwfee/dsh-genui
description: DeepSeek Harness 的生成式 UI 插件：模型用 render_ui 工具直接写一段 React 代码，回答里就地渲染成一张可交互卡片，而不是只给文字。附带一个内置 skill，教模型什么时候值得用界面、什么时候一段话就够。代码在插件自己的沙箱里求值：fetch / XMLHttpRequest / 定时器 / require / window / document / localStorage 全部被屏蔽，卡片崩溃由错误边界接住并退回源码。 / Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness: the model calls render_ui with a snippet of React and the answer renders as an interactive card in the conversation. Ships one built-in skill that teaches when a UI is worth it. The snippet is evaluated in a plugin-owned sandbox with network, timers, module loading and DOM globals masked; a crashing card falls back to its source.
author: HwFee <1744567281@qq.com>
